CREATE VIEW ads.dim_account (`科目键` Int32, `科目` String, `科目方向` String, `科目有父级` UInt8) AS SELECT AccountKey AS `科目键`, AccountName AS `科目`, AccountType AS `科目方向`, ParentAccountKey IS NOT NULL AS `科目有父级` FROM retail.DimAccount
CREATE VIEW ads.dim_channel (`渠道键` Int32, `渠道` String) AS SELECT ChannelKey AS `渠道键`, ChannelName AS `渠道` FROM retail.DimChannel

CREATE VIEW ads.dim_customer (`客户键` Int32, `客户性别` Nullable(String), `客户婚姻状况` Nullable(String), `客户学历` Nullable(String), `客户职业` Nullable(String), `客户年收入档` Nullable(Float64), `客户子女数` Nullable(Float64), `客户是否有房` Nullable(Float64), `客户城市` Nullable(String), `客户省州` Nullable(String), `客户国家` String, `客户大洲` String) AS SELECT c.CustomerKey AS `客户键`, c.Gender AS `客户性别`, c.MaritalStatus AS `客户婚姻状况`, c.Education AS `客户学历`, c.Occupation AS `客户职业`, c.YearlyIncome AS `客户年收入档`, c.TotalChildren AS `客户子女数`, c.HouseOwnerFlag AS `客户是否有房`, g.CityName AS `客户城市`, g.StateProvinceName AS `客户省州`, g.RegionCountryName AS `客户国家`, g.ContinentName AS `客户大洲` FROM retail.DimCustomer AS c LEFT JOIN retail.DimGeography AS g ON c.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey

CREATE VIEW ads.dim_date (`日期` Date, `年` Int32, `月` Int32, `月名` String, `季度` String, `半年` String, `周` String, `周起始日` Date, `月起始日` Date, `季起始日` Date, `星期` String, `星期序号` Int32, `是否工作日` String, `是否节假日` String, `欧洲季节` String, `北美季节` String, `亚洲季节` String) AS SELECT DateKey AS `日期`, CalendarYear AS `年`, MonthNumber AS `月`, CalendarMonthLabel AS `月名`, CalendarQuarterLabel AS `季度`, CalendarHalfYearLabel AS `半年`, CalendarWeekLabel AS `周`, toMonday(DateKey) AS `周起始日`, toStartOfMonth(DateKey) AS `月起始日`, toStartOfQuarter(DateKey) AS `季起始日`, CalendarDayOfWeekLabel AS `星期`, CalendarDayOfWeekNumber AS `星期序号`, IsWorkDay AS `是否工作日`, IsHoliday AS `是否节假日`, EuropeSeason AS `欧洲季节`, NorthAmericaSeason AS `北美季节`, AsiaSeason AS `亚洲季节` FROM retail.DimDate

CREATE VIEW ads.dim_product (`产品键` Int32, `产品名` String, `品牌` Nullable(String), `厂商` Nullable(String), `颜色` Nullable(String), `产品档位` Nullable(String), `备货档位` Nullable(String), `产品标价` Nullable(Float64), `产品单位成本` Nullable(Float64), `产品状态` Nullable(String), `子类` String, `品类` String) AS SELECT p.ProductKey AS `产品键`, p.ProductName AS `产品名`, p.BrandName AS `品牌`, p.Manufacturer AS `厂商`, p.ColorName AS `颜色`, p.ClassName AS `产品档位`, p.StockTypeName AS `备货档位`, p.UnitPrice AS `产品标价`, p.UnitCost AS `产品单位成本`, p.Status AS `产品状态`, psc.ProductSubcategoryName AS `子类`, pc.ProductCategoryName AS `品类` FROM retail.DimProduct AS p LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS psc ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = psc.ProductSubcategoryKey LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON psc.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
CREATE VIEW ads.dim_product_category (`品类键` Int32, `品类` String) AS SELECT ProductCategoryKey AS `品类键`, ProductCategoryName AS `品类` FROM retail.DimProductCategory

CREATE VIEW ads.dim_promotion (`促销键` Int32, `促销名` String, `名义折扣率` Nullable(Float64), `促销类型` Nullable(String), `是否打折促销` UInt8) AS SELECT PromotionKey AS `促销键`, PromotionName AS `促销名`, DiscountPercent AS `名义折扣率`, PromotionType AS `促销类型`, PromotionKey != 1 AS `是否打折促销` FROM retail.DimPromotion
CREATE VIEW ads.dim_scenario (`场景键` Int32, `场景` String) AS SELECT ScenarioKey AS `场景键`, ScenarioName AS `场景` FROM retail.DimScenario

CREATE VIEW ads.dim_store (`门店键` Int32, `门店名` String, `门店类型` Nullable(String), `门店状态` Nullable(String), `门店开业日` Nullable(String), `门店营业面积` Nullable(Float64), `门店员工数` Nullable(Float64), `门店经理` String, `门店经理职级` Nullable(String), `门店城市` Nullable(String), `门店省州` Nullable(String), `门店国家` String, `门店大洲` String) AS SELECT s.StoreKey AS `门店键`, s.StoreName AS `门店名`, s.StoreType AS `门店类型`, s.Status AS `门店状态`, s.OpenDate AS `门店开业日`, s.SellingAreaSize AS `门店营业面积`, s.EmployeeCount AS `门店员工数`, concat(e.FirstName, ' ', e.LastName) AS `门店经理`, e.Title AS `门店经理职级`, g.CityName AS `门店城市`, g.StateProvinceName AS `门店省州`, g.RegionCountryName AS `门店国家`, g.ContinentName AS `门店大洲` FROM retail.DimStore AS s LEFT JOIN retail.DimEmployee AS e ON toInt32(s.EmployeeKey) = e.EmployeeKey LEFT JOIN retail.DimGeography AS g ON s.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
